vtopt/delaunaysparse.manifest:
name = "delaunaysparse"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "MIT"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
[build]
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true
[fortran]
source-form = "default"
implicit-external = true
implicit-typing = true

scope: Version 1 multivariate interpolation using sparse Delaunay simplices. Version 2 bundles BQPD with a research-only redistribution notice, so the selected pin uses the earlier MIT-licensed version 1 with its bundled SLATEC/BLAS/LAPACK sources. An FPM wrapper retains fixed/free source forms, legacy implicit typing/interfaces and -fallow-argument-mismatch for the SLATEC scalar-zero/zero-stride BLAS convention. OpenMP is enabled to link the library; the checked driver uses the serial routine. It verifies exact linear-function reproduction at three interior 2D points, zero status codes, valid simplex indices and barycentric weight sums/signs. No numerical source edits. Convex-hull projection/extrapolation, all degenerate inputs, high-dimensional behavior and parallel variants are not validated.
pin_reason: Version 2 bundles research-only BQPD; inspect version 1 which uses SLATEC instead.
compatibility_settings: FPM source-form default preserves fixed-form legacy .f files.
The library allows legacy implicit typing and interfaces.
-fallow-argument-mismatch accepts the documented SLATEC scalar-zero/zero-stride DCOPY call.
